lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiFeO2 (Li4Fe4O8, 16 atoms per cell) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2_1/c (No. 14), with four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li centers have five O neighbors and O centers have four neighbors (one Fe and three Li). Fe octahedra share corners and edges with one another, and corner- or edge-sharing also occurs between Fe octahedra and Li 5-vertex polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
